triage_requests.text: Home policy, region R07 Front Range. Hailstorm on 2 Oct damaged roof tiles and two skylights. Contractor estimate $8,400. Photos attached. Policy in force since 2021.

offline_decision.rationale: Storm damage to the roof is covered under H5.2; estimate is within standard handler authority and far below the R07 Home limit.

triage_requests.text: Contents policy, region R29 New York Metro. Laptop bought in 2019 stolen from apartment, police ref NYPD-55120 filed same day. Replacement cost $2,100.

offline_decision.rationale: Theft with timely police report is covered; electronics older than 5 years settle at depreciated value (minimum 25% of replacement).

triage_requests.text: Motor Private, region R10 Gulf Coast West. Rear-ended at a red light by an identified driver who admitted fault. Repair estimate $4,900. No injuries.

offline_decision.rationale: Comprehensive own-damage claim within authority; the other party is identified and at fault, so flag for subrogation recovery.

triage_requests.text: Landlord policy, region R18 Appalachia. Property vacant for 75 days; burst pipe discovered on return, ceiling collapsed. Estimate $22,000.

offline_decision.rationale: Escape of water while the property was unoccupied for more than 60 consecutive days is excluded under H6.2.

triage_requests.text: Small Business Property, region R23 South Florida. Storm surge flooded the shop floor; stock loss claimed at selling price $96,000 plus 3 weeks of lost revenue.

offline_decision.rationale: R23 is flood-excluded, stock must be valued at cost, business interruption is always referred and the amount exceeds senior authority.

memo_requests: Summarize what the last quarter's flood-excluded-region claims mean for our Small Business Property appetite on the Gulf Coast.
Draft a memo on whether Gulf Coast flood exclusions are driving Small Business Property complaints.
Give the committee a one-page view of Small Business Property flood exposure in flood-excluded regions.
memo_offline:
## Situation
Flood-excluded regions R10, R11, R21 and R23 produced most declined Small Business Property flood claims last quarter.

## Evidence
Schedule rows show deductibles of $1,800-$2,250 and CAT surge x1.50 in these regions; H5.2 excludes flood there.

## Recommendation
Offer an optional flood endorsement priced from the R23 schedule row, and tighten appetite for ground-floor retail in R23.

skill_requests.text: Claim CLM-7731 (Contents, region R04): policy started 9 days ago, cover was raised to $60,000 last week, and the claimant reports theft of a new $9,800 camera kit but has no receipts. Is this suspicious?
What is the notification deadline for a motor claim?
